player_prompt.intro:
Uri kuri Tower of Hanoi na {num_disks} disks.
Wakora disks kuva kuri tower A hadi kuri tower C.
Igihe ukora disk, andika tower ya kubanza na tower ya kugera (kwa mfano, '[A C]').
Tanga kwamba wewe ushobora gusa kukora disk ya kwanza ya tower, na kwamba disk kubwa haiwezi kuhorwa kwenye disk ndogo.
Kuwe na kila mukino, tuma igikorwa kimwe.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Watanze isôko canke umunara wo gushikako bidafise agaciro.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Wagerageje gukura iforoma ku munara utagira ico ushinzwe.
invalid_move.same_tower: Wagerageje kwimurira iforoma muri iyo nyubakwa nyene.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Wagerageje gushira icuma kinini ku kindi gitoyi.

game_action.moved: Waciye uhindura disiki {disk} ukava kuri {source} ukinjira muri {target}.

outcome.win: Urakoze, waratorotse igisigabwenge c'umunara wa Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Urashoboye gushira {pct}% vy'ibipande ku Munara C.
